message: Asahi and Ririmu returned to the classroom after their match.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That was so much fun~！ A clash that didn't even let you catch your breath！ Felt like a truly touching super-spectacle！」

name: Momiji
message: 「It was intense, alright. Or rather, stiflingly passionate. It really felt like the definition of youth.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please stop, it’s embarrassing…」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Haaah~~！！ Man, that felt refreshing~~！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, yeah, after going that wild.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still, it’s amazing, right? A draw even after such an intense fight！ Draws in Jindou are pretty rare, aren’t they?」

name: Momiji
message: 「In reality, it was probably a double knockout because they both ran out of Tenju. It is pretty rare, I think.」
It just goes to show how evenly matched their abilities were this time.

name: Iori
message: 「The two of you, do you understand each other a bit better now？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, maybe.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I understand, but… Ririmu-san’s brazenness toward Iori-sensei is still quite excessive.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, Ririmu has her own strong feelings, in her own way.」

name: Iori
message: 「I like that Ririmu sticks to her own methods like that, and I have never once thought of her as arrogant.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Te, Teacher…」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, you’re too soft…」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu is fine just the way she is, that’s what I believe. So Asahi, I want you to accept her as she is too.」

name: Asahi
message: 「…Understood. I will do my best.」
I turned back to face Ririmu.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, Asahi is always pure and positive about the things she believes in… she’s very earnest.」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s why she can’t forgive those who deny those things. That’s what’s manifesting as her sharp tongue.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, I get that. Asahi is definitely like that, isn't she?」

name: Iori
message: 「But in truth, she’s a very serious, dedicated, and wonderful girl who cares deeply for her brother.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I don’t really care about my brother at all.」

name: Iori
message: 「See? She says things like that, but you saw how angry she got earlier, didn't you?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, she totally snapped, it was seriously scary」

name: Iori
message: 「Deep down, she's just jealous of free-spirited girls like you, Ririmu. Seeing people like that gets on her nerves」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahahaha, so that's what it was~」

name: Asahi
message: 「That's not true!」
Asahi puffing out her cheeks.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, Asahi」

name: Asahi
message: 「...What is it？ Is there something else you haven't finished saying？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I think I might've misjudged you a little」

name: Ririmu
message: 「At first I thought you were just some annoying jerk always picking fights, but well, I guess everyone's got their own stuff going on」

name: Asahi
message: 「Their own stuff」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Plus, Asahi, you were pretty awesome out there. Honestly, I didn't think you were that strong」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Before we started, I was totally thinking it'd be a piece of cake~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, I had a tough time with your big bro Takahisa at first too, but now I can beat him pretty reliably」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So I figured his little sister would be easy peasy♪, and then... you were crazy fast and rock-solid！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「And hey, how'd you pull that off？ You know, seeing right through my illusion and coming straight at me？ That seriously freaked me out」

name: Asahi
message: 「Th-That was just a hunch. If I had guessed wrong, I believe I would have been at a disadvantage」
Asahi, overwhelmed by Ririmu's rapid-fire questions. She responds with a deflated, bewildered look.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Anyway, whatever the case, sorry about earlier. I'd get mad too if someone made fun of something important to me」

name: Ririmu
message: 「After fighting you, I totally felt your worldview loud and clear. Your Iai quick-draw, your feelings for your big bro, all that stuff」

name: Asahi
message: 「As I said, I don't feel anything in particular toward my brother」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Also, to be real with you, I think you're stronger than your big bro, Asahi」

name: Asahi
message: 「Stronger than my brother...？ If that's true, I'm happy to hear it, but objectively speaking, I still believe I fall far short of him」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way, Asahi, you were seriously strong！ You should be proud of yourself！ I guarantee it！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Thank you very much」
Asahi started fidgeting bashfully. That's a rare sight.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san... you weren't just all talk; you truly have solid skill.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I went too far with what I said as well. I'm sorry.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, don't sweat it—I'll probably have forgotten all about it by tomorrow anyway. I'm not the type to hold onto that kinda stuff.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, that's a wonderful trait to have.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...You're not dissing me right now, are you？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Not at all. I genuinely mean it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I see... Well then, how about we both call it even for today？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, let's do that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa~ A historic reconciliation has been achieved~!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well then, Iori-sensei, we've got to have them keep their promise.」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, that's right.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hm？ What promise was that again？」

name: Iori
message: 「The promise was that once the match was over, no matter who won, you two would shake hands and make up, remember？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehh~ Come on, skip that! It's embarrassing!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Indeed, we've already made up.」

name: Iori
message: 「Nope, no getting out of it—a promise is a promise.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehhh~?! Are we seriously doing this~?」

name: Asahi
message: 「I-If Iori-sensei insists...」
Reluctantly, the two of them reach out their hands to each other.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, you two, get along from now on, okay?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「W-Well, as long as Asahi doesn't throw any weird insults at me!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Only if Ririmu-san refrains from being selfish, that is.」

name: Iori
message: 「No attaching weird conditions.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Asahi... let's start fresh and get along, okay?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, likewise」
Holding hands, the two of them shared a bashful laugh.
